```{r}
getwd()
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)

# ---- Load data ----
df1 <- read.table("/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/genetic_correlations/results/genetic_correlations_RS/ldsc/20251107/all_results_ldsc.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, quote = "")
df2 <- read.table("/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/genetic_correlations/results/genetic_correlations_NealeEdu_Alzheimers/ldsc/20251107/all_results_ldsc.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, quote = "")


# Combine
df <- bind_rows(df1, df2)

# ---- Keep only scientifically relevant comparisons ----
df <- df %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Okbay|NealeEdu", p1) & grepl("Belloy|NealeEdu", p2)
  )

# ---- Clean file names ----
df$p1 <- basename(df$p1)
df$p2 <- basename(df$p2)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    p1_label = case_when(
      grepl("Okbay2022educ", df$p1) ~ "Education (Okbay 2022, Meta)",
      grepl("NealeEduFemale", df$p1) ~ "Education (Female, Neale 2018)",
      grepl("NealeEduMale", df$p1) ~ "Education (Male, Neale 2018)",
      grepl("NealeEdu2018", df$p1) ~ "Education (All, Neale 2018)",
      TRUE ~ df$p1
    ),
    p2_label = case_when(
      grepl("Belloy2024FinnGenfemales", df$p2) ~ "AD (Female, Belloy 2024)",
      grepl("Belloy2024FinnGenmales", df$p2) ~ "AD (Male, Belloy 2024)",
      grepl("Belloy2024FinnGensexhet", df$p2) ~ "AD (Combined, Belloy 2024)",
      grepl("NealeEduMale", df$p2) ~ "Education (Male, Neale 2018)",
      grepl("NealeEduFemale", df$p2) ~ "Education (Female, Neale 2018)",
      TRUE ~ df$p2
    )
  )
# ---- Add group labels for clarity ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      grepl("Okbay", p1) ~ "Meta-Education vs AD",
      grepl("NealeEdu2018", p1) ~ "Neale (All) vs AD",
      grepl("NealeEduMale|NealeEduFemale", p1) & grepl("Belloy", p2) ~ "Sex-stratified Education vs AD",
      grepl("NealeEduMale|NealeEduFemale", p1) & grepl("NealeEdu", p2) ~ "Sex-stratified Education vs Education",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# ---- Create pair label ----
df <- df %>% mutate(pair = paste(p1_label, "→", p2_label))

# ---- Filter to only meaningful categories ----
df <- df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Meta-Education vs AD", "Neale (All) vs AD", 
                      "Sex-stratified Education vs AD", "Sex-stratified Education vs Education"))

# ---- Add significance and order ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p < 0.05, "Significant", "Not significant")) %>%
  arrange(group, rg)

df$pair <- factor(df$pair, levels = unique(df$pair))

# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rg, y = pair, color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(y = pair, xmin = rg - se, xmax = rg + se),
                width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = paste0("p=", signif(p, 2))), size = 3, nudge_x = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#0072B2", "Not significant" = "gray70")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic correlation (rg)",
    y = "",
    title = "LDSC Genetic Correlations Between Education and Alzheimer's Disease",
    subtitle = "Overall and sex-stratified analyses across Okbay and Neale education GWAS",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("LDSC_combined_facet_plot.png", p, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
